Method of Attack: Remote code execution via file upload of malicious WordPress plugin through the upload_and_install_pro() function
Exploitation of missing access check on module.php loaded during admin_init action
Exploitation possible by any logged-in user including subscribers due to nonce exposure in admin page source code
Attack Vector: Authenticated user (including subscriber role) exploiting missing access control to upload malicious plugin
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of malicious plugin file uploaded via upload_and_install_pro() function
Nonce value exposed in elementorCommonConfig in admin page source code
